{70!O[1dT4z,;X=s:.QW.text:
Once you've added yourself to the project you can add yourself to the thumbnail! I recommend grouping your characters in their thumbnail poses before adding them to it.

---- Make sure you haven't broken any of the rules below before sharing this project. If you have, fix them up or your remix may be declared UNOFFICIAL! ----
Only @Burgnew_On_A_Laptop, @TheDiamondDoggy,
@Aydenfox8, @s-dbayer, @Kyle3912Again and @chomperthegamer are allowed to break these rules.
Rules marked with a (!) can only be broken by @Burgnew_On_A_Laptop, nobody else! 

(!) 1. It is polite and REMIX ETIQUETTE to comment "Remixing..." in the comments before starting a remix, so people know not to accidentally split the remix tree's branches. If you don't intend to make a new remix branch, then don't remix if someone has commented "Remixing..."!
(!) 2. DO NOT BREAK THE COMMUNITY GUIDELINES!! That means nothing too scary or vulgar & no swear words!
(!) 3. Don't add or remove anyone from the breaking rules list without Burgnew's permission! Furthermore, don't delete any of these rules or instructions & don't change the project title either!
(!) 4. Please make sure you credit @-Rex- for being the creator of the Pen Text Engine++ used in this project!
( https://scratch.mit.edu/projects/406678232/ )
5. Don't delete or modify any players you didn't make, or any marbles or scripts for that matter! Mr. Player-Template's only here to help... ;-; People allowed to break rules are allowed to do this if they need to fix a glitch.
6. Please don't change the hitbox's shape or size, everyone needs to have the same-sized hitbox to give everyone the same chances.
7. Don't make your characters too large, that would make it hard to see.
8. Don't add any singular climbers that appear to be 2 separate characters (EG: Mario & Luigi both as 1 player) unless they are stuck together with no feasible way to physically detach them.
9. Don't delete any music tracks unless they break the community guidelines or they don't loop (looking at you @legofan208 ) If you don't want to listen to a certain song or genre, utilize the "audio exemption" functionality to make sure you can't.
10. On the topic of music, please also refer to the Music comment's recommended music limit so that @Burgnew_On_A_Laptop doesn't suffer too much lag from this project.
11. You can add yourself to the thumbnail, but please don't delete any characters off it or completely change it altogether!
12. If you are part of the "breaking rules" list, you're allowed to add a new rule if needed. Remember to add it to both this comment and the project's instructions!

Oh, and don't delete this comment either. (!)

XB[F0+^F`knh8`CxR_}F.text:
Change all the "voice" sound clips to your own character's voice! If your character doesn't have a voice, you can mute the voice-clips. You can add as many Receive voice-clips as you'd like, but remember to set the "Number of ReceiveBomb voice clips"

VOICE-CLIP GUIDE:
ReceiveBomb: A worried or annoyed phrase or grunt the character says when a bomb is passed to them. Some characters will have a different amount of these than others.
Danger!: A frightened, anxious or dejected-sounding exclamation a character makes if a bomb they're holding is about to explode! It's recommended you don't make this longer than 1.5 seconds so that it isn't interrupted by them being KO'd.
KO!: Screaming & shouting as they are blown up & knocked out of the game!
HitScreen: A muffled grunt the character makes if they manage to slam into the fourth wall while being KO'd.
Win!: The character's victory phrase for when they outlast all the others and win the game!

cWFd0[4s$;7!KuV)}NF4.text:
Hey there! If you want to add your own music, first separate your song into it's intro (if it has an intro) and it's looping part in separate sounds, tag "-Start" at the end of the intro's name, then tag "-Loop" at the end of the looping part's name. Add the song's name into either "Add music" block, depending on if it's for the main gameplay or end-game results, & finally drop it here! Remember that EVERYTHING must be correct spelling or else it won't work! Running a test recommended!

If the music track comes from a party game, like Mario Party, Wii Party or WarioWare: MEGA Party Game$, make sure it won't play for users who don't want those music tracks, like SmashBrosFan2020. If the music track gets faster overtime, make sure it won't play for users who don't want those music tracks, like Twin138956Scratch. I, Burgnew_On_A_Laptop, also recommend you please don't add any more than around 60 music tracks total, to prevent lag or the dreaded "refusal-to-save glitch" when modifiying the project on less powerful devices. It's also best to refrain from adding too many music tracks longer than 3 minutes (180 seconds) or too many "gets faster" tracks.
